name: obs-mcp
description: Read, search, edit and reorganise Obsidian vaults directly on disk, safely: etag-checked minimal edits, link-aware renames, dry runs and undo.
long_description: obs-mcp works on your vault folders directly; Obsidian doesn't need to be running. Every change to an existing file needs the etag of Claude's latest read, so edits made in Obsidian are never overwritten. Edits patch only the changed bytes, renames and moves rewrite the links that would break, every write has a dry run, deletes go to the vault's .trash, and undo_last_write reverses the last change. It never runs code, plugins, Templater or URIs, and has no network access.

tools.name: list_vaults
tools.description: List the configured vaults; the first is the default.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List files in a folder of the vault, optionally recursively and filtered by a glob such as Projects/**/*.md.

tools.name: get_note_info
tools.description: Show a file's etag, properties, tags, outline, block IDs and link counts.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note, one heading's section, one block or a line range, with its etag.

tools.name: read_notes
tools.description: Read up to 20 whole text files at once, each with its etag.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search of the notes with tag, property, path and date filters.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the vault's tags with note counts, including parent tags of nested tags.

tools.name: find_by_property
tools.description: Find notes by a property's value, or by having the property.

tools.name: backlinks
tools.description: List the links from other files that point at a file, with source and line.

tools.name: outgoing_links
tools.description: List a file's links and embeds, each with the file it resolves to, or its candidates when ambiguous.

tools.name: unresolved_links
tools.description: List links that point at no file, with source and line.

tools.name: orphans
tools.description: List files that no other file links to.

tools.name: resolve_link
tools.description: Resolve a link the way Obsidian does, from the note it is written in.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note (.md); fails if it exists.

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Edit a note in place with small patches; everything outside the edited ranges stays byte for byte.

tools.name: replace_note
tools.description: Replace a note's whole text; prefer edit_note.

tools.name: set_properties
tools.description: Set frontmatter properties of a note, checked against the vault's property types.

tools.name: remove_properties
tools.description: Remove frontmatter properties from a note.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Move a note or other file to the vault's .trash folder.

tools.name: restore_from_trash
tools.description: Move a file from .trash back to where it was, or to another path.

tools.name: list_trash
tools.description: List the files in the vault's .trash folder, with the path restore_from_trash takes.

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move a note or file, rewriting every link that would break.

tools.name: rename_note
tools.description: Rename a note or other file in its folder, rewriting every link to it like move_note.

tools.name: move_folder
tools.description: Move a folder and everything in it, rewriting links like move_note.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder and any missing parents.

tools.name: rename_heading
tools.description: Rename a heading in a note and update every [[Note#Heading]] link to it, including #Parent#Child chains.

tools.name: rename_block
tools.description: Rename a block ID (^id) in a note and update every [[Note#^id]] link to it.

tools.name: rename_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag in every note, inline and in frontmatter, ignoring case.

tools.name: rename_property
tools.description: Rename a frontmatter property in every note that has it.

tools.name: open_daily_note
tools.description: Open the daily note for a date (default today), creating it from the daily-note template if it doesn't exist.

tools.name: append_to_daily_note
tools.description: Append text to the daily note for a date (default today), creating the note first if needed.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the notes in the vault's template folder (Templates plugin setting).

tools.name: create_from_template
tools.description: Create a note from a template in the template folder.

tools.name: attach_file
tools.description: Copy a local image, audio, video or PDF file into the vault's attachment folder and return the embed text.

tools.name: read_canvas
tools.description: Read a canvas's nodes, edges and spec problems, with its etag.

tools.name: edit_canvas
tools.description: Add, update and remove canvas nodes and edges, checked against JSON Canvas 1.0.

tools.name: create_canvas
tools.description: Create a new canvas (.canvas), empty or with add_node and add_edge ops.

tools.name: read_base
tools.description: Read a base's views, filters, formulas and problems, with its etag.

tools.name: create_base
tools.description: Create a new base (.base) from YAML text, checked against the Bases syntax.

tools.name: edit_base
tools.description: Set, remove or insert values in a base's YAML, checked against the Bases syntax.

tools.name: undo_last_write
tools.description: Undo the newest change made through this server, including a whole move or rename.

vaults.title: Vault folders
vaults.description: One or more Obsidian vault folders. The first is the default for every tool.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Only offer the reading tools; Claude can't change any file.

deny.title: Hidden paths
deny.description: Comma-separated globs that no tool can see, read or write, such as Journal/**,Private/**. Leave empty to hide nothing.

journal.title: Keep undo history
journal.description: Keep the previous version of every changed file (up to 500 MB, in ~/.local/state/obs-mcp/journal) so undo_last_write can reverse changes.
